title: Rat It: Plague Hunter
description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD

Об игреARE YOU READY FOR ADVENTUREAs an outlaw alchemist drifting around the ocean. While exploring an abandoned pirate ship, You have uncovered rats who have been corrupted by the evil spirits of the deep. It is your duty to pick up magical slingshot paired with alchemical projectiles to exterminate these monsters and uncover the secret in the ship.

WIELD YOUR SLINGSHOT
• Dynamic VR aiming and shooting mechanism with the magical Slingshot. 

• Don't hesitate to shoot the devil creature.

SPECIAL PROJACTILE
• Use different types of projectiles to develop your own style of strategy and grow as you play.

RICH CONTENT AND UNIQUE CREATURE
• Meticulously crafted level designs and engaging interactive elements.

• Advanced AI and mysterious evil boss. Learn to exploit their weaknesses.
description_short: Rat It: Plague Hunter is a single-player magic shooter game in VR. As the alchemist, you must wield your powerful slingshot eradicate all the evil monsters on a medieval sailing ship.
